changeSet.author: casemgmt
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE CM_CASE_DEF_RELEASE DROP CONSTRAINT CK_CM_CDR_STATUS
ALTER TABLE CM_CASE_DEF_RELEASE ADD CONSTRAINT CK_CM_CDR_STATUS CHECK (STATUS_ IN ('DRAFT','VALIDATED','DEPLOYING','ACTIVE','FAILED','RETIRED'))
UPDATE CM_CASE_DEF_RELEASE SET ACTIVATED_AT_ = PUBLISHED_AT_ WHERE STATUS_ = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE CM_CASE_DEF_RELEASE SET STATUS_ = 'FAILED', FAILURE_DETAIL_ = SUBSTR( CASE WHEN FAILURE_DETAIL_ IS NULL THEN '' ELSE FAILURE_DETAIL_ || '; ' END || 'Exact process definition identity unresolved by migration; activation repair required', 1, 2000) WHERE KIND_ = 'ORCHESTRATION' AND STATUS_ = 'ACTIVE' AND ENGINE_DEPLOYMENT_ID_ IS NOT NULL AND (ENGINE_PROC_DEF_ID_ IS NULL OR ENGINE_PROC_DEF_KEY_ IS NULL OR ENGINE_PROC_DEF_VER_ IS NULL)

ALTER TABLE CM_CASE_DEF_RELEASE ADD CONSTRAINT CK_CM_CDR_EXACT_ID CHECK ( STATUS_ != 'ACTIVE' OR ENGINE_DEPLOYMENT_ID_ IS NULL OR (ENGINE_PROC_DEF_ID_ IS NOT NULL AND ENGINE_PROC_DEF_KEY_ IS NOT NULL AND ENGINE_PROC_DEF_VER_ IS NOT NULL))

ALTER TABLE CM_CASE_DEF_RELEASE ADD CONSTRAINT CK_CM_CDR_LIFECYCLE_TS CHECK ( (STATUS_ != 'ACTIVE' OR ACTIVATED_AT_ IS NOT NULL) AND (STATUS_ != 'RETIRED' OR (ACTIVATED_AT_ IS NOT NULL AND RETIRED_AT_ IS NOT NULL)) AND (RETIRED_AT_ IS NULL OR ACTIVATED_AT_ IS NULL OR RETIRED_AT_ >= ACTIVATED_AT_))

changeSet.author: casemgmt
changeSet.sql: UPDATE CM_CASE_DEF_BINDING b SET ORCHESTRATION_MODE_ = ( SELECT d.ORCHESTRATION_MODE_ FROM CM_CASE_DEF d WHERE d.ID_ = b.CASE_DEF_ID_)

UPDATE CM_CASE_DEF_BINDING b SET (ENGINE_DEPLOYMENT_ID_, ENGINE_PROC_DEF_ID_, ENGINE_PROC_DEF_KEY_, ENGINE_PROC_DEF_VER_, ENGINE_TENANT_ID_) = ( SELECT r.ENGINE_DEPLOYMENT_ID_, r.ENGINE_PROC_DEF_ID_, r.ENGINE_PROC_DEF_KEY_, r.ENGINE_PROC_DEF_VER_, r.ENGINE_TENANT_ID_ FROM CM_CASE_DEF_RELEASE r WHERE r.ID_ = b.ORCH_RELEASE_ID_)

UPDATE CM_CASE_DEF_BINDING SET STATUS_ = CASE WHEN ORCHESTRATION_MODE_ = 'PLAN_MODEL' AND DEPLOY_STATUS_ = 'ACTIVE' THEN 'ACTIVE' WHEN ORCHESTRATION_MODE_ = 'PLAN_MODEL' AND DEPLOY_STATUS_ = 'FAILED' THEN 'FAILED' WHEN ORCHESTRATION_MODE_ = 'PLAN_MODEL' THEN 'DRAFT' WHEN DEPLOY_STATUS_ = 'ACTIVE' AND ENGINE_DEPLOYMENT_ID_ IS NOT NULL AND ENGINE_PROC_DEF_ID_ IS NOT NULL AND ENGINE_PROC_DEF_KEY_ IS NOT NULL AND ENGINE_PROC_DEF_VER_ IS NOT NULL THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'FAILED' END, FAILURE_DETAIL_ = CASE WHEN ORCHESTRATION_MODE_ = 'BPMN' AND (ENGINE_DEPLOYMENT_ID_ IS NULL OR ENGINE_PROC_DEF_ID_ IS NULL OR ENGINE_PROC_DEF_KEY_ IS NULL OR ENGINE_PROC_DEF_VER_ IS NULL) THEN 'Exact process definition identity unresolved by migration; binding repair required' ELSE FAILURE_DETAIL_ END
UPDATE CM_CASE_DEF_BINDING SET ACTIVATED_AT_ = BOUND_AT_ WHERE STATUS_ = 'ACTIVE'
ALTER TABLE CM_CASE_DEF_BINDING ADD CONSTRAINT CK_CM_CDB_MODE_V2 CHECK (ORCHESTRATION_MODE_ IN ('PLAN_MODEL','BPMN'))
ALTER TABLE CM_CASE_DEF_BINDING ADD CONSTRAINT CK_CM_CDB_LIFECYCLE CHECK (STATUS_ IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','RETIRED','FAILED'))

ALTER TABLE CM_CASE_DEF_BINDING ADD CONSTRAINT CK_CM_CDB_EXACT_ID CHECK ( STATUS_ != 'ACTIVE' OR ORCHESTRATION_MODE_ = 'PLAN_MODEL' OR (ENGINE_DEPLOYMENT_ID_ IS NOT NULL AND ENGINE_PROC_DEF_ID_ IS NOT NULL AND ENGINE_PROC_DEF_KEY_ IS NOT NULL AND ENGINE_PROC_DEF_VER_ IS NOT NULL))

ALTER TABLE CM_CASE_DEF_BINDING ADD CONSTRAINT CK_CM_CDB_LIFECYCLE_TS CHECK ( (STATUS_ != 'ACTIVE' OR ACTIVATED_AT_ IS NOT NULL) AND (STATUS_ != 'RETIRED' OR RETIRED_AT_ IS NOT NULL) AND (RETIRED_AT_ IS NULL OR ACTIVATED_AT_ IS NULL OR RETIRED_AT_ >= ACTIVATED_AT_))

changeSet.author: casemgmt
changeSet.sql: UPDATE CM_CASE_DEF_BINDING binding SET (CASE_DEF_KEY_, TENANT_ID_) = ( SELECT definition.KEY_, definition.TENANT_ID_ FROM CM_CASE_DEF definition WHERE definition.ID_ = binding.CASE_DEF_ID_)

MERGE INTO CM_CASE_DEF_BINDING target USING ( SELECT CASE_DEF_ID_ FROM ( SELECT binding.CASE_DEF_ID_, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY definition.TENANT_ID_, definition.KEY_ ORDER BY definition.VERSION_NO_ DESC, binding.BOUND_AT_ DESC NULLS LAST, binding.CASE_DEF_ID_ DESC ) AS authority_rank FROM CM_CASE_DEF_BINDING binding JOIN CM_CASE_DEF definition ON definition.ID_ = binding.CASE_DEF_ID_ WHERE binding.STATUS_ = 'ACTIVE' ) WHERE authority_rank > 1 ) duplicate ON (target.CASE_DEF_ID_ = duplicate.CASE_DEF_ID_) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.STATUS_ = 'RETIRED', target.DEPLOY_STATUS_ = 'FAILED', target.RETIRED_AT_ = CASE WHEN target.ACTIVATED_AT_ IS NOT NULL AND target.ACTIVATED_AT_ > SYSTIMESTAMP THEN target.ACTIVATED_AT_ ELSE SYSTIMESTAMP END, target.FAILURE_DETAIL_ = SUBSTR( 'Retired by migration because a newer active binding exists for this tenant and case definition key' || CASE WHEN target.FAILURE_DETAIL_ IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '; ' || target.FAILURE_DETAIL_ END, 1, 2000)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UQ_CM_CDB_ACTIVE_KEY ON CM_CASE_DEF_BINDING ( CASE WHEN STATUS_ = 'ACTIVE' THEN TENANT_ID_ ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN STATUS_ = 'ACTIVE' THEN CASE_DEF_KEY_ ELSE NULL END)

changeSet.author: casemgmt
changeSet.sql: UPDATE CM_LINKED_PROCESS lp SET IS_CASE_ROOT_ = 1 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CM_CASE c WHERE c.ID_ = lp.CASE_ID_ AND c.ROOT_PROC_INST_ID_ = lp.PROC_INST_ID_)

UPDATE CM_CASE c SET ROOT_CORRELATION_ID_ = ROOT_PROC_INST_ID_, ROOT_PROC_INST_ID_ = NULL WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CM_LINKED_PROCESS lp WHERE lp.CASE_ID_ = c.ID_ AND lp.IS_CASE_ROOT_ = 1 AND lp.ENGINE_SYNC_ = 'PENDING' AND lp.PROC_INST_ID_ = c.ROOT_PROC_INST_ID_)
UPDATE CM_LINKED_PROCESS SET CORRELATION_ID_ = PROC_INST_ID_, PROC_INST_ID_ = NULL WHERE ENGINE_SYNC_ = 'PENDING'
ALTER TABLE CM_LINKED_PROCESS ADD CONSTRAINT CK_CM_LPROC_ROOT_FLAG CHECK (IS_CASE_ROOT_ IN (0, 1))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UQ_CM_LPROC_CONF_ROOT ON CM_LINKED_PROCESS ( CASE WHEN IS_CASE_ROOT_ = 1 AND PROC_INST_ID_ IS NOT NULL THEN CASE_ID_ ELSE NULL END)
